PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
                                  MINUTES

A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, April 16, 2024, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Scott Roybal, Chairman, Pete Layboum (via Zoom), Dr. Rinne
(joined the meeting during discussion of item #20), and Tom Segrave.


                                    AGENDA ITEMS

11.    ORDINANCE          READING        Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                          —




       Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from MUB Mixed-Use Business Emphasis to
       CB Community Business for land located at Lot 2, Block 1, Q-B Subdivision. (SPONSOR
       -MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Seth Lloyd, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

12.    ORDINANCE          READING Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, High
                                        —




       Plains Road beginning at South Greeley Highway and terminating at Division Avenue.
       (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on        reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Sophia Maes, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons,
AVI P.C. provided additional information. Chairman Roybal and committee member Segrave
commented on the item.

13.    ORDINANCE —2” READING              —Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, land
       located east of Saratoga Street and west of Whitney Road. (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
                                                                              —




Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2” reading, seconded by Mr. Layboum. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report.

14.    ORDINANCE _2uidT READING           Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                          —




       Cheyenne establishing the zoning classification of AR Agricultural Residential for land
       annexed to the City of Cheyenne located east of Saratoga Street and south of and adjacent
       to Laramie Street. (SPONSOR MR. ROYBAL)
